tagline: Practice, learn and track your progress.
description: ZCat is a computer-assisted learning app for practising tests, reading teaching materials and following your progress. It runs entirely in the browser and is hosted as a static site.
features: Timed tests with fast, normal and easy pacing
Random test generation (GenTest) and saved tests (MyTest)
Light and dark modes with several colour themes
motivation: If you’re not learning, you’re not improving.
Small steps every day beat big leaps once in a while.
Mistakes are proof that you are trying.
Every question you answer makes the next one easier.
Stay curious. The best learners never stop asking why.
Consistency is the quiet secret behind every skill.
